# Lua global functions

The 722 global functions Project Zomboid exposes to Lua, 751 signatures counting overloads.

**How this was established.** Every public method of `zombie.Lua.LuaManager$GlobalObject` in `projectzomboid.jar`, read with `javap -p`. Kahlua's `LuaJavaClassExposer` publishes that class into the Lua global namespace, so each method below is callable from Lua by its bare name with no receiver: `getPlayer()`, not `GlobalObject.getPlayer()`.

Java types are shown with their package stripped. `KahluaTable` is a Lua table crossing the boundary; `ArrayList<T>` and other Java collections arrive as Java objects and are indexed with `:get(i)` from 0, never with `[i]`.

A name absent from this file is not a global function of this build. Report that rather than guessing a spelling.
